figures.title: CdTe/PU film and mixed-emitter comparisons
figures.summary: Panels a/b show transparent flexible green/red films; c gives red-left and green-right fluorescence images. Panel d compares their spectra. Panel e compares separate mixed-emitter films at 1 and 1.5 umol/cm2 under 450 nm excitation. No green:red ratio or exact physical-batch join is inferred.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
